title: Mushroom Oracle Gathering
description: A surreal night scene features three green-skinned women with elaborate pink and purple leaf headdresses sitting beneath a massive glowing mushroom. The enormous mushroom cap displays intricate circular patterns, white dripping liquid, and multiple small silhouetted human figures arranged in rings.
prompt: Surreal nighttime forest scene with three green-skinned women wearing elaborate pink fern headdresses sitting together under a giant glowing mushroom. The massive mushroom has a yellow-green cap covered in white circles and rings of tiny silhouetted human figures, purple dripping liquid, and a tree-like stem. Dark mysterious forest with ruins and glowing orbs in the background, mystical and psychedelic atmosphere, rich vibrant colors with purple and green tones.
